data.name: Mannan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-n-n' meaning 'to support, to help, to comfort'. In Islamic tradition, Mannan is a name for those who provide support and comfort to others.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying the divine support and comfort of Allah.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Mannan resonates with the energy of change, freedom, and excitement. It suggests a free-spirited, adventurous, and adaptable personality.

in_arabic.name: منان
in_arabic.meaning: الله کے احسانات و کرم کا مطلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: منان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اللہ کے احسانات و کرم سے وابستہ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ جو احسان کرتا ہے، یا احسانات کا سرچشمہ ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں اس نام کی جڑ منّان ہے، جو احسان کرنے والے کی صفت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: منان
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کے احسانات کا مطلب، کرمگار
in_urdu.long_meaning: منان نام اللہ کی ایک صفت سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے احسان کرنے والا یا کرم کرنے والا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے، جو اللہ کے احسانات و کرم کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मन्नान
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की कृपा का अर्थ, अनुग्रहकारी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मन्नान नाम भगवान की एक विशेषता से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अनुग्रह करने वाला या कृपा करने वाला। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है, जो भगवान की कृपा और दया की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: منان
in_pashto.long_meaning: منان نوم د الله د يوه صفت څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د احسان کولو مانا لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې مشهور دی، چې د الله د احساناتو او کرم يادونه کوي.

in_english.name: Mannan
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'mannan', meaning bountiful or benefactor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mannan originates from the Arabic root 'm-n-n', signifying 'bountiful' or 'benefactor'. It is associated with Quranic references to Allah's benevolence. Historically, it symbolizes divine generosity and grace, reflecting a spiritual significance in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: In various Islamic communities, Mannan is a popular baby name given to encourage a sense of kindness, compassion, and generosity towards others. People with the name Mannan are expected to be caring, selfless, and understanding individuals. In many rural communities, those named Mannan are often given the role of caretakers and providers, and are looked upon for support and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mannan carries deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is believed that the name Mannan is a reflection of Allah's attribute of being the Supporter and Helper. By giving their child this name, parents pray for their child to embody the qualities of compassion, kindness, and a helping nature, and to constantly seek Allah's support and guidance in their lives. The name Mannan serves as a reminder to always be there for others, to provide comfort and support to those in need and to remember that Allah is always there to provide support and comfort to us.

historical_references.reference: Mannan I bin Ahmad Al-Farghani, an influential Persian scholar and scientist during the Abbasid Caliphate (750-1258 AD). He is renowned for his extensive work in mathematics, astronomy, and physics, and was the first to calculate the value of pi to nine decimal places.

Mannan Dhu-al-Qadir, a title given to the supreme deity in the pre-Islamic Arabian religion of Bakkah (Mecca) worshipped by the ancient tribe of Qusayy. The name Mannan Dhu-al-Qadir signifies the 'All-Powerful, All-Compelling One', reflecting the belief in the supreme power and control of the deity over the universe.
